⚠️ **This card exists so a ruled remainder does not lose its carrier.** PR objectui#10081 closes objectui#9819 with `Fixes`, and it lands the CEILING half in full — but ⛔ not the narrowing half of the same ruling.

## What the ruling asks, and what landed

Ruling batch **#162 item 1, letter A** (objectui#9819, comment `5729875720`, maintainer 「同意」 2026-09-18T12:18Z) carries the prose 「`rowActions` chooses among what `operations` allows and can only narrow」.

| half | state |
| --- | --- |
| CEILING — `operations: { update: false }` withholds row editing whatever `rowActions` says | ✅ **LANDED** in PR objectui#10081; both gates (`rowCrudAffordances.ts`, edit AND delete) went from `(operationsX \|\| wantXAction) && hasOnX` to `operationsX && hasOnX` |
| NARROWING — `rowActions` further restricts within what `operations` allows | ⛔ **NOT LANDED** |

## Why it could not land there — a real obstacle, ⛔ not a shortcut

The gate cannot tell **「`rowActions` absent」** from **「`rowActions` present but not naming this action」**: `ObjectGrid.tsx` passes `rowActionsList.includes('edit')`, and an absent `rowActions` becomes an **empty array**, so both arrive as the same `false`. Narrowing on that `false` would close the generic Edit/Delete on **every grid that declares no `rowActions`** — the exact outcome the same ruling forbids one sentence earlier (「`operations` absent ⇒ today's defaults」).

⇒ the only value of that conjunct preserving the ruling's own invariant at this call site is `true`, which collapses it away. ⭐ The dev did ⛔ not widen the PR to fix it, and did ⛔ not leave it silent: the gap is **PINNED** by a case named `⚠️ NOT IMPLEMENTED — rowActions does not NARROW inside the ceiling`, so implementing the narrowing turns that pin RED.

## Surface and sequencing

Needs a caller-side 「`rowActions` was declared」 signal that only `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` can produce, plus `resolveRowCrudAffordances`' signature. ⚠️ `ObjectGrid.tsx` is **objectui#9837's** surface (ruled A′) ⇒ sequence this **after** objectui#9837, ⛔ never alongside it.
